text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh? Where did I read up to?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The words are just sliding off the page... 
Maybe I'm tired...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm curious about what happens next, 
but... I'll save it for another time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Zenno Rob Roy still has lingering 
fatigue from the race. We might need to 
reconsider her race schedule.
